posts.title: When Resources Are Rare
posts.description: At this point, the global compute resource crunch has come for us all, from Big Tech to the average consumer. How do we run organizations that operate in a world of finite and constrained resources?

posts.title: Escape from Metrics Hell
posts.description: Uh-oh, you’ve been plugging away at this feature launch for months and you just can’t get the metrics to be positive enough to ship. Is your launch cooked? What to do when you just can’t get your experiment metrics to go green.

posts.title: AI Nutrition Facts
posts.description: Below is an edited copy of a memo I circulated at work. Various folks had been growing weary of reviewing AI slop. In this memo, I made the case for AI disclosures in written or generated artifacts. What do you think?
